svg.title: Loom internal deployment – target architecture
svg.text: Loom for AWS — internal deployment, target architecture
Management plane on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB inside the existing platform VPC; agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime in VPC network mode.
same region as the AgentCore platform
reused: subnets, NAT and IGW already exist
internal · HTTPS 443 · TLS 1.3 · nodes in both AZs
ECS may place tasks in either private subnet.
RDS subnet group spans both AZs.
public endpoints, reached through the NAT gateway:
AgentCore deploy + invoke (SSE), Bedrock, Secrets Manager,
S3, CloudWatch, Cognito JWKS, ECR image pulls
Sign-in (InitiateAuth, USER_PASSWORD_AUTH) over the internet → ID + access JWT
provisions ENI in the private subnet
Private traffic inside the VPC / via private connectivity
Traffic to public AWS endpoints (Cognito, DNS, AWS APIs via NAT)
